svg.aria-label: Atharva Lakhe. I build software that listens for help, sees in permanent shadow, reads a district from orbit, catches a rewritten record, argues before it advises, and guards a freelancer's scope.

g.text: 276 recordings in street noise, zero false triggers
20.28 dB against 17.27 dB on 24 held-out scenes
every figure carries its scene IDs and parameter hash
SHA-256 and proof-of-work written from scratch
four agents, and the coordinator may never average
every piece of evidence stored with its SHA-256 hash
